div.p: Where elite training meets luxury experience. Join thousands of members who have redefined their limits at PowerFit.

PowerFit is where science meets passion. Our world-class facility combines cutting-edge equipment, elite coaching, and a community-driven culture to help you achieve results that last. We don't just build bodies — we build lifestyles.
From high-intensity training to mindful recovery — every program is engineered for results.
One-on-one sessions with certified elite trainers. Your program, your pace, your transformation.
State-of-the-art free weights and machines. Build strength, power, and a physique you're proud of.
Advanced cardio zones with immersive tech. Burn more, recover faster, perform at your peak.
Restore balance and flexibility in our zen-inspired studio. Mind and body in perfect harmony.
Maximum results in minimum time. Our HIIT classes are scientifically designed for afterburn.
Fuel your goals with personalized nutrition plans crafted by certified sports dietitians.
Build power, agility and mental toughness with expert-led boxing and combat fitness sessions.
Stretch zones, foam rolling, and guided recovery sessions to keep your body performing at its peak.
World-class coaches with proven track records. Your transformation starts with the right mentor.
NSCA-certified strength coach specializing in athletic performance and muscle hypertrophy.
500-hour certified yoga instructor blending traditional practices with modern sports science.
Former pro athlete turned high-performance coach. Specializes in metabolic conditioning.
Don't take our word for it. Hear directly from members who changed their lives at PowerFit.

"PowerFit completely transformed how I see fitness. Within 6 months I lost 40 lbs and gained the confidence I never thought I'd have. The trainers here are on another level — they genuinely care about your progress."
"The yoga and nutrition program here is unlike anything I've experienced. Maya helped me rebuild my relationship with my body. I'm stronger, more flexible, and at peace with myself than ever before."
"Marcus pushed me beyond limits I didn't know I had. The HIIT program is brutal but the results speak for themselves. I ran my first marathon at 42 — something I thought was impossible."
Flexible plans designed to match your goals, schedule, and lifestyle. No hidden fees.
